verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Netlify serves an llms.txt at docs.netlify.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), headed 'LLM documentation for Netlify' and described as comprehensive platform documentation. The docs also include a section on sharing context and connecting AI assistants to a Netlify account, which supports the agent-oriented docs side of the story. Missing for 10: the probe excerpt is truncated, so the depth of the llms.txt content (e.g., an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown) is unverified, and no independent hands-on report confirms agents use it effectively.
